title: Intuitive Machines, Inc. Q2 2026 Form 10-Q
excerpt: Q2 revenue was USD 206.168 million, quarter-end backlog USD 1.762 billion, cash USD 367.354 million, long-term debt USD 336.352 million, and six-month free cash outflow USD 145.819 million.
summary: The Q2 Form 10-Q is the latest periodic filing and supplies current operating scale, backlog quality, cash burn, liquidity, debt, outstanding and potentially dilutive claims, acquisition costs, and Goonhilly subsequent-event terms.
